---
name: specification
description: "Turn established intent, repository evidence, and resolved decisions into a durable implementation contract."
---

# Specification

Write for a capable implementer entering cold.

Include only sections the task needs. A small change may need goal, current behavior, desired behavior, constraints, and verification. Larger work may also need design decisions, contracts, failure behavior, migration, rollout, or non-goals.

Separate observed repository facts from decisions. Resolve material contradictions before calling the spec ready.

Acceptance must describe observable behavior. Verification must name a credible way to observe it without overfitting to temporary implementation details.

Make the artifact durable and self-contained enough that a clean session does not need the discovery chat or scout transcripts.
